A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] was a member of the [[Singing Mountain Clan]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She served as a guardian and practiced tirelessly for when she might be called upon to defend the clan.
